This page quickly catalogs and summarizes the available data.

::: {.manual-prereq title="Inputs Staged Successfully"}

The staged-input inventory target from page 16 must have completed. Confirm
that its file paths can be read from the target store before inspecting data.

```{r}
stopifnot(all(file.exists(targets::tar_read(s0_pipeline_inputs_raw_chr))))
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Document The Input Data"}

```{r}
library(targets)
library(dplyr)
library(skimr)

tar_load(s0_pipeline_inputs_raw_chr)
```

Use this target-backed inventory in an authorized data session to document
the source schema, record grain, keys, reporting periods, and missing-value
conventions. This scaffold does not yet declare source-specific analysis;
record the reviewed contract before adding readers or curation targets.
:::

::: {.manual-check title="Confirm The Inspection Decision"}

This page is complete only when the accountable reviewer has approved a source
contract precise enough to test. Until then, do not register a source reader or
curation target.

:::
